title: Add pytest-asyncio as a test dependency
description: Introduce a [test] optional-dependencies group in pyproject.toml and add pytest-asyncio to it. Also add asyncio_mode = 'auto' to [tool.pytest.ini_options] so async test functions are discovered without per-test decorators.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml contains [project.optional-dependencies] with a 'test' key listing pytest-asyncio
Running `uv pip install -e '.[test]'` installs pytest-asyncio without error
